conversation.text: Sawubona Rumi! Ngisanda kuqeda isifundo semisindo neBanga loku-1.
conversation.en: Hello Rumi! I have just finished the phonics lesson with Grade 1.

conversation.text: Sawubona thisha! Ngiyajabula ukuxhumana nawe. Sihambe kanjani isifundo semisindo namuhla?
conversation.en: Hello, teacher! I am glad to connect with you. How did today's phonics lesson go?

conversation.text: Sihambe kahle, kodwa abanye abafundi basadida umsindo omusha 'hl' nomsindo 'l'.
conversation.en: It went well, but some learners still mix up the new sound 'hl' with the sound 'l'.

conversation.text: Lokho kuvamile. Kusasa, qala ngemizuzu emihlanu yokuphinda imisindo: wena usho umsindo, abafundi baphinde, bese bewubhala emoyeni. Bese nihlanganisa amagama amafushane afana nelithi hlala.
conversation.en: That is common. Tomorrow, start with five minutes of sound revision: you say the sound, the learners repeat it, then they write it in the air. Then blend short words such as 'hlala'.
Thank you, I will try that tomorrow.

conversation.text: Wenza umsebenzi omuhle kakhulu, thisha. Ukuphinda nsuku zonke kuyasiza. Uzofundisa muphi umsindo olandelayo ngesonto elizayo?
conversation.en: You are doing very good work, teacher. Revising every day helps. Which sound will you teach next week?
